description_en: Queries the information about a DMS data warehouse development project workspace by workspace name
description_zh: 调用GetLhSpaceByName接口，根据DMS数仓开发项目空间名查询项目空间信息
name: GetLhSpaceByName

parameters.help_en: The name of the project workspace
parameters.name: space_name

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: tid

LakehouseSpace.description_en: The data warehouse development project workspace

CreatorId.description_en: The user ID of the project workspace creator
CreatorId.description_zh: 项目空间创建者的用户ID

Description.description_en: The description of the project workspace

DevDbId.description_en: The database ID of the development database

DwDbType.description_en:
The database type. Currently, only the following types are supported:
14: AnalyticDB for MySQL
18: AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL
DwDbType.description_zh:
数据库类型，当前仅支持：
14：AnalyticDB MySQL版
18：AnalyticDB PostgreSQL版

Id.description_en: The ID of the project workspace

IsDeleted.description_en:
Indicates whether the project workspace is deleted. Valid values:
true: The project workspace is deleted.
false: The project workspace is not deleted
IsDeleted.description_zh:
是否已删除。返回值如下：
true：项目空间已删除
false：项目空间没有被删除

Mode.description_en:
The mode of the project workspace. Valid values:
0: simple mode
1: standard mode
Mode.description_zh:
项目空间模式，返回值如下：
0：简单模式
1：标准模式

ProdDbId.description_en: The database ID of the production database

SpaceConfig.description_en:
The project workspace configuration. The following configuration items are supported:
skipManualRunCheck: Skips security rule checks for trial runs.
skipPublishApprove: Skips approval for publishing and O&M operations
SpaceConfig.description_zh:
项目空间配置，支持的配置项：
skipManualRunCheck：试运行免安全规则检查。
skipPublishApprove：发布、运维免审批

SpaceName.description_en: The name of the project workspace

TenantId.description_en: The tenant ID of the project workspace

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:
true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败
